mapper.sql: id, title, description, image_urls, category, location, lost_time, contact, item_type, publisher_id, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select
from lost_item
status = #{status} and status != 'DELETED'
status = 'OPEN'
and item_type = #{itemType}
and category = #{category}
and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or location like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by created_at desc
select distinct category from lost_item where category is not null and category != '' and status != 'DELETED' order by category
select item_type as name, count(1) as value from lost_item where status != 'DELETED' group by item_type
select category as name, count(1) as value from lost_item where status != 'DELETED' and category is not null and category != '' group by category order by value desc limit 8
